newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO Pacific places 250 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: COSCO Pacific places 250 mln shrs.

text.p: COSCO Pacific Ltd was placing 250 million shares at HK$6.20 each to finance container purchases, lead underwriter Goldman Sach said on Monday.

COSCO Pacific would place 250 million new shares, representing 15 percent of its existing share capital, with investors priced at a 5.3 percent discount to the shares' Monday close of HK$6.55, an executive at Goldman told Reuters.
The issue had been over subscribed and would be allocated to private investors in Hong Kong, Asia, Europe and the United States, he added.
Barclays de Zoete Wedd is joint lead for the deal.
COSCO Pacific's parent COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd's 64.17 percent interest was expected to be diluted following the new share issue but Goldman did not give a figure.
COSCO Pacific, a container leasing firm, is ultimately controlled by Chinese state-owned China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO), it largest customer.
